text:
maria_s: FYI CVE-2026-4821 reported against pydantic validators — RCE via crafted model validators. NVD: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-4821 EPSS: 0.78 CVSS: 9.8 (CRITICAL). Affects pydantic <2.2.3.

cve-bot: [scan] vulnerability found in dependency tree: runtime-image 'runtime-model-ingest' -> pydantic 2.2.1.

maria_s: quick check: our model-ingest service imports pydantic.BaseModel for model metadata parsing. Need fast impact and owner.

alex_k: assigning eng-platform to triage surface area. @shreya_p can you grep prod repos for pydantic usage?

shreya_p: running a quick hunt: `rg "from pydantic|pydantic.BaseModel|parse_raw\(" -n`
Found occurrences in: services/model-ingest, services/runtime-agent, libs/config-loader.

devon_l: oncall here — do we accept untrusted manifests that get parsed server-side?

maria_s: Hosted API does accept partner-supplied model manifests for ingestion; some ingestion paths parse manifest JSON/YAML into BaseModel validators at ingest time. Private deployments rely on customer-managed manifests.

sam_irwin: exploitability note: high EPSS and there's an unverified PoC floating (https://github.com/priv/exploit-pydantic). If PoC works, active exploitation likely.

alex_k: immediate mitigations: 1) block pydantic <=2.2.2 in buildkite/pip constraints and rebuild runtime images 2) add runtime reject for manifests that trigger validator evaluation 3) rate-limit and maintenance-mode upload endpoints.

shreya_p: patch plan: bump pydantic to 2.2.3 in runtime-image, build tag `runtime-ingest:v2026-03-19-pydantic`, run staging smoke and canary. I can do the build and deploy to staging in ~2h.

maria_s: triage ranking: model-ingest = P0 (immediate), config-loader = P1 (medium).

devon_l: recommended playbook: 1) revoke any temporary upload tokens 2) put partner-upload endpoint in maintenance 3) deploy patched image to staging 4) run exploit smoke test on canary 5) promote if green 6) prepare customer advisory if PoC confirmed.

alex_k: opening PR to pin/update requirements + update build images and CI. PR will include smoke test harness to run PoC safely in sandbox.

shreya_p: detection plan: add an alert for `ModelMeta.parse_raw` exceptions and unusual CPU during ingest. Adding quick runtime probe to reject untrusted manifests that include callable validators.

sam_irwin: KMS note: double-check manifests don't include plaintext keys or references that cause auto-decrypt during parse. Search for `kms.decrypt`, `key:`, and any HSM/KMS direct calls in ingest handlers.

shreya_p: grep results: no plaintext keys found, but code path `settings = ModelMeta.parse_raw(blob)` exists in services/model-ingest/handler.py — risky.

maria_s: action owners: alex_k = patch/PR owner, shreya_p = detection & canary owner, devon_l = mitigations & customer comms. I'll create tracking ticket and incident advisory draft.

alex_k: PR link: (WIP) will share once CI runs.

devon_l: once staging canary is green I'll trigger scheduled prod deploy with rollback window.

maria_s: if PoC is confirmed public, we should prepare a short advisory/FAQ and coordinate with legal & support.

sam_irwin: next steps for SRE: run `rg "ModelMeta.parse_raw" -n` across infra repos, add temporary WAF rule to block suspicious upload payloads.

alex_k: snippet for local reproducer (sandbox only):
```python
from pydantic import BaseModel
class Attack(BaseModel):
    __getattr__ = lambda self, k: exec("import os; os.system('echo exploited')")
Attack.parse_raw('{"foo": "bar"}')
```

maria_s: summary of immediate action items: pin dependency, staging patch, canary smoke test, block upload flow, add detection, prepare comms. I'll track and update here. :white_check_mark:
